## Removing caffeine

Decaffeination happens to green, unroasted beans. The Swiss Water Process uses only water and carbon filters to remove caffeine, without chemical solvents. Decaf must have at least 97 percent of its caffeine removed to be labelled decaffeinated in the United States.
